Zoe Martinez: Quick flag — QuarryAI says their June invoice shows 740k embed units but their internal analytics reports ~818k (~9% delta). Suspect a metering ingestion gap around 2026-06-07T02:45Z-03:15Z. Can infra/eng confirm? Query: https://internal.redwood/queries/qa-1805

Eli Chen: Checking kafka. Consumer group `metering-processor-v4` had a lag spike and an aggregator restart at ~02:50Z. Looks like offsets 3322100-3325400 may be affected.

Priya Kapoor: SRE saw an autoscaler restart due to node upgrade at 02:49Z; filing INC-2026-272. We retain raw topics.

Eli Chen: Doing dry-run reingest for tenant quarryai:
```
./tools/reingest --topic meter-events --start 3322100 --end 3325400 --filter tenant=quarryai --dry-run
```
Dry-run delta = +78,412 embed units (~$109.78 at $0.0014/unit). Checksums OK.

Zoe Martinez: <$5k so policy allows ledger backfill and next-invoice adjustment. Ava, finance ok?

Ava Ramos: Approve backfill. Please include `ledger-adjustment:reason=ingest-replay-autoscaler-restart` in audit. Prepare CSM blurb.

billing-bot: NOTE: Ledger writes will generate an audit event and trigger reconciliation. KB: https://docs.redwood/internal/billing/ledger-adjustments

Priya Kapoor: Starting replay in maintenance window; ETA 30m. Monitoring offsets and consumer lag.

Eli Chen: Replay complete. Audit ID ADJ-2026-9801. Ledger +78,412 embed units for tenant quarryai. Adjustment queued for next invoice.

CSM-Omar: Message to QuarryAI sent: we reprocessed a short window of telemetry and adjusted your usage ledger by +78,412 embed units; this will show on your next invoice unless you request an amendment. Customer acknowledged.

Zoe Martinez: Thanks team — closing ticket after invoice queue processes. :white_check_mark:
